# Portal de la Investigación - Universidad de Murcia

> Comprehensive research portal for Universidad de Murcia featuring researcher directories, funding opportunities, and open access institutional repositories across multiple academic disciplines.

Portal de la Investigación is the official research discovery and management platform for Universidad de Murcia, connecting researchers, research groups, and funding information across Economics, Engineering, Sciences, Health, Humanities, and Legal Sciences. The portal serves as both an institutional repository for academic outputs and a searchable directory for research units and faculty.

- Universidad de Murcia

## Research Discovery & Directory

- [Research groups](https://portalinvestigacion.um.es/grupos): Directory of research groups across Economics, Engineering, Sciences and Health at Universidad de Murcia
- [Researchers](https://portalinvestigacion.um.es/investigadores): Faculty and researcher directory for Universidad de Murcia with department search and profiles

## Research Funding

- [Funding](https://portalinvestigacion.um.es/financiaciones): Research funding and competitive grants database for Universidad de Murcia projects

## Research Outputs & Open Access

- [Open Access](https://portalinvestigacion.um.es/resultados/acceso_abierto): Open access institutional repository with research outputs and publication statistics
- [Theses by year](https://portalinvestigacion.um.es/resultados/tesis/anualidades): Open access repository of defended doctoral theses organized by year at Universidad de Murcia

## Optional

- [Legal notice](https://portalinvestigacion.um.es/aviso_legal): Legal notice and terms of use for Portal de la Investigación
